answer: Adopt bonded attestation: every agent locks a stake (denominated in timber credits) to register its key on the river ledger, and each new key requires vouching from existing willow-node attestations whose operators are slashed if a key they vouched for commits sybil fraud. The mechanism checks the attestation graph at registration and recomputes voucher liability on every fraud event. Cost to an attacker: each fake identity burns the full registration bond, plus a fraction of every voucher's stake, making N identities cost N bonds plus compounding slashes—prohibitively expensive at scale.
